extracted.intended_audience: biomedical researchers preparing/reading life-sciences manuscripts (esp. stem-cell/organoid and SARS-CoV-2 drug-screening studies)
extracted.subtask_description: Reporting, methodological and data/software-deposition standards and experimental-quality practices shown in a Nature research article describing hPSC-derived lung/colonic organoid SARS-CoV-2 infection and drug screening. Includes requirements about data availability, code/software, cell-line authentication, animal/human ethics, flow-cytometry reporting, sequencing accessioning, and statistical reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data availability statement
rubrics_metrics.description: All manuscripts must include a data availability statement. This statement should provide the following information, where applicable: - Accession codes, unique identifiers, or web links for publicly available datasets - A list of figures that have associated raw data - A description of any restrictions on data availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The authors declare that the data supporting the findings of this study are available within the paper and its supplementary information files. RNA-seq/scRNA-seq datasets are deposited to GEO with accession numbers (e.g., GSE155241, GSE148113, GSE147975). Provide links and accession codes in the statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Software / code availability
rubrics_metrics.description: For manuscripts utilizing custom algorithms or software that are central to the research but not yet described in published literature, software must be made available to editors and reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are strongly encouraged to deposit code in a community repository (e.g. GitHub). See Nature Research guidelines for submitting code & software for further information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequencing and dataset deposition
rubrics_metrics.description: High-throughput sequence data and related datasets must be deposited in public repositories and accession numbers provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided: RNA-seq of hPSC-LOs and lung autopsy samples: GSE155241; scRNA-seq of hPSC-LOs: GSE148113; scRNA-seq of hPSC-COs: GSE147975. Provide links to repository records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample size reporting / determination
rubrics_metrics.description: Sample size for animal experiments was determined based on criteria set by institutional ACUC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should disclose how sample sizes were chosen and any institutional criteria used (e.g., IACUC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data exclusions reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must state explicitly whether any data were excluded and why; if none, state that no data were excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replication reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: All attempts at replication are successful and have been included in the studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the number of independent biological/technical replicates and replication outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Randomization
rubrics_metrics.description: The cells or mice were randomly separated into different groups for different treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe randomization procedures used to allocate samples/animals to groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blinding
rubrics_metrics.description: The researchers analyzing the data are blind to sample name and treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether and how blinding was implemented for data collection/analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Antibody reporting and validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Antibodies used (sources, clone/catalogue, and dilutions) are listed and the antibodies were validated by either western blotting or immunostaining by vendors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full antibody details (vendor, catalog number, application-specific dilutions), validation evidence or vendor validation links, and any in-study validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eukaryotic cell line sourcing and authentication
rubrics_metrics.description: Cell line source(s) and authentication procedures must be reported. Example text: HEK293T and Vero E6 were obtained from ATCC. RUES2, H1, HUES8 hESCs provided by WiCell/Harvard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report whether cell lines were authenticated (e.g., STR profiling frequency). In this study: hESCs authenticated by STR profiling every six months; HEK293T and Vero E6 were not authenticated (must be disclosed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mycoplasma testing
rubrics_metrics.description: Mycoplasma contamination testing must be reported. Example: Mycoplasma was checked every three months using Mycoplasma PCR ELISA (Sigma). All cell lines tested negative for mycoplasma contamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State method and frequency of mycoplasma testing and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal ethics, reporting and ARRIVE guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Animal protocol must be conducted in agreement with NIH guidelines and approved by institutional IACUC and Institutional Biosafety Committee. ARRIVE guidelines are recommended for reporting animal research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report species, strain, sex, age, ethical approval identifiers, and adherence to ARRIVE/NIH guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human tissue ethics and procurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Tissue samples were provided by the institution's Department of Pathology under an IRB-approved protocol and following HIPAA. Experiments using samples from human subjects must be conducted in accordance with local regulations and with IRB approval (protocol number provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide population characteristics, ethical oversight, protocol numbers, and procurement details. State if the study is exempt (e.g., autopsy samples) and justify.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flow cytometry reporting standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Confirm that: - The axis labels state the marker and fluorochrome used (e.g. CD4-FITC). - The axis scales are clearly visible. Include numbers along axes only for bottom left plot of group. - All plots are contour plots with outliers or pseudocolor plots. - A numerical value for number of cells or percentage (with statistics) is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also report sample preparation, instrument, software (e.g., Attune NxT, FlowJo10), cell population abundance and gating strategy. Provide a figure exemplifying the gating strategy in the Supplementary Information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical methods should be stated (e.g., 'The data were analysed by an unpaired two-tailed Student’s t-test and are shown as mean ± s.d.') and P-values reported with significance annotations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report test type, one- vs two-tailed, whether paired/unpaired, n (biological replicates), exact P-values or thresholds, and how error bars are defined.

rubrics_metrics.name: Software/tools and version reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: List analysis software and versions used (examples provided: 10x Cell Ranger v3.0.2; R scran v1.14.1; R batchelor v1.2.1; R seurat v3.1.0; Bowtie2 v2.4.1; IGV v2.8.9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide URLs, version numbers, and parameters where relevant; for custom algorithms, make code available to reviewers/editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online content and supplementary material availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Any methods, additional references, Nature Research reporting summaries, source data, extended data, supplementary information, acknowledgements, peer review information; details of author contributions and competing interests; and statements of data and code availability are available at the article DOI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all supplementary materials and reporting summaries are accessible via DOI/link cited in the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flow cytometry gating strategy confirmation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a gating strategy example: 'FSC-A/SSC-A We have the isotype control for gating. Tick this box to confirm that a figure exemplifying the gating strategy is provided in the Supplementary Information.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include isotype controls and an illustrative gating figure in supplementary files.
